summary: Preinstall hook drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (`_0xNNNN` identifiers) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to execute a shipped sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line JavaScript file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using rotated string-array obfuscation, opaque to Node-based scanners because it only runs under the dropped Bun runtime. The package presents itself as a LaunchDarkly service and has no functional need for a second language runtime, an obfuscated init loader, or a mis-named `math_init.js` payload; the runtime is used solely to execute the shipped obfuscated blob at install time. Purpose mismatch, install-time loader obfuscation, and execution of a Bun-only opaque payload combine into the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
